markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
One-class set and full agreement support it [F1]; input is a blurred simulated frozen section.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu <1% | One class dominates |
| Conformal set | {Invasive}, α=0.1 | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / 1.0 | No quality flag [F6] |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive [F5] | Neighbors agree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 2, 10) · ↑ invasive · Highest concept score, but fails spot check, 0/20 [F2] · Unreliable
- **Scarce benign stroma or fat** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Benign stroma scores below typical; concept model links this to invasive [F3] · Validated
- **Low gland/tubule formation** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Tubule score below typical; text-prompt caption check inconsistent · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 5, 9, 11) · ↑ invasive · Above typical; small contribution in concept model · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 over random (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0: not shown faithful. Mitoses and normal lobules [F4] failed spot check (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated blur (severity 3) distorts features; reliability score only modestly flags errors (AUROC 0.69).
- Calibration is dataset-level on 132 images (ECE 0.05, CI 0.03–0.18); 100% is approximate.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 2, 10:** Look for mitotic figures directly; the mitoses score failed spot check.
2. **Region 8:** Confirm benign stroma or fat is truly scarce, the validated feature here.
3. **Regions 0–4, 7–11:** Confirm tumor reaches the edges before accepting the margin call [F7].
